name: es31-compute-indirect-and-to-render
title: Indirect dispatch and compute to render
summary: GPU-driven work: glDispatchComputeIndirect with group counts written by earlier compute passes (compaction chain, ten overlapping byte offsets with a zero count, image-size-derived counts) and its errors; a compute shader that writes vertices, indices and a DrawElementsIndirect command (firstIndex 2, baseVertex 3, count from an atomic counter) which is then drawn after VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY | ELEMENT_ARRAY | COMMAND barriers; glMemoryBarrierByRegion between fragment-shader passes (image chain, image store -> texelFetch, buffer store -> buffer load), pixel by pixel against CPU models.
spec: ES 3.2 §17 Compute Shaders: DispatchCompute, DispatchComputeIndirect (command layout, offset must be a multiple of 4, errors for a negative / unaligned offset, a command beyond the buffer end, no buffer bound, no program)

ES 3.2 §10.3.9 Indirect Commands in Buffer Objects (Table 10.4: DRAW_INDIRECT_BUFFER, DISPATCH_INDIRECT_BUFFER), §10.5 Drawing Commands Using Vertex Arrays (DrawElementsIndirect and its command structure, firstIndex and baseVertex)

ES 3.2 §7.11.2 Shader Memory Access Synchronization: MemoryBarrier (VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY, ELEMENT_ARRAY, COMMAND, SHADER_STORAGE, TEXTURE_FETCH, FRAMEBUFFER, BUFFER_UPDATE bits) and MemoryBarrierByRegion (only ATOMIC_COUNTER, FRAMEBUFFER, SHADER_IMAGE_ACCESS, SHADER_STORAGE, TEXTURE_FETCH and UNIFORM are legal; the region may be as small as one pixel)

ES 3.2 §7.11.1 Shader Memory Access Ordering (one fragment invocation per pixel without multisampling), §8.23 Texture Image Loads and Stores (r32ui read-write image, r32f / rgba8 images), §7.8 Shader Storage Blocks, §2.3.1 Errors (an erroring command has no effect)

GLSL ES 3.10 §7.1.3 Compute Shader Special Variables (gl_NumWorkGroups, gl_WorkGroupID, gl_LocalInvocationIndex, gl_GlobalInvocationID), §4.4.5 / §4.3.7 shader storage blocks and std430, §8.11 atomicAdd, §8.12 Image Functions

api.glDispatchComputeIndirect: group counts written by compute passes (compaction chain: ceil(761/64) = 12 groups; image fill: 8x8 from imageSize; a 12-word table dispatched from ten byte offsets 0..36 including three zero-count commands): launched groups, invocations, gl_NumWorkGroups and every group id counted exactly once; errors INVALID_VALUE (offsets 2, 6, -4), INVALID_OPERATION (offsets size-8, size, 1 MiB, no buffer bound, no program) launch nothing; offset size-12 is accepted
api.glDispatchCompute: generation, finalize, compaction, table-writing and image-setup passes (single group); a direct one-group dispatch is the negative control of the indirect chain
api.glDrawElementsIndirect: UNSIGNED_INT triangles from a compute-written command {15, 1, firstIndex 2, baseVertex 3, 0}: the 5 surviving triangles appear in their colors at the CPU centroids, the 3 culled sectors and the gaps show the clear color
api.glMemoryBarrier: SHADER_STORAGE between generation and finalize, VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY | ELEMENT_ARRAY | COMMAND before the draw, COMMAND before every indirect dispatch, TEXTURE_FETCH | FRAMEBUFFER before sampling / glReadPixels, BUFFER_UPDATE before MapBufferRange: consumers see the data the CPU model predicts; ALL_BARRIER_BITS raises no error
api.glMemoryBarrierByRegion: SHADER_IMAGE_ACCESS (five-pass r32ui chain, 16384 pixels), TEXTURE_FETCH (image store then texelFetch, 8192 pixels), SHADER_STORAGE (buffer store then load, 8192 pixels) between fragment-shader passes: every pixel equals the CPU model; the six legal bits and ALL_BARRIER_BITS raise no error
api.glGenBuffers: vertex / index / command, compaction input / work / output, table, probe and fragment storage buffers
api.glBindBuffer: DISPATCH_INDIRECT_BUFFER, DRAW_INDIRECT_BUFFER, ARRAY_BUFFER and ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER bindings consumed by the commands; COPY_READ / COPY_WRITE for uploads and mapping
api.glBindBufferBase: SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER binding points 0..3 of the compute and fragment shaders
api.glBufferData: initial contents (junk vertices, sentinel output, input data) that must survive where the shaders do not write
api.glBufferSubData: resets the work / output / probe buffers between experiments
api.glMapBufferRange: reads vertex, index, command, work, output and probe words after BUFFER_UPDATE_BARRIER_BIT; compared word by word with the model
api.glEnableVertexAttribArray: attributes 0 (position) and 1 (sector) read from the compute-written vertex buffer
api.glVertexAttribPointer: vec2 position at offset 0, stride 16: positions of the drawn triangles match the CPU centroids
api.glVertexAttribIPointer: uint sector attribute at offset 8, stride 16: the palette color of every triangle depends on it
api.glGenVertexArrays: VAO that records the vertex and ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER bindings (glDrawElementsIndirect needs a non-default VAO)
api.glBindVertexArray: VAO bound for the indirect draw and an empty VAO for the gl_VertexID triangles
api.glBindImageTexture: rgba8 image sized by imageSize (readonly writeonly), writeonly rgba8 fill, r32ui read-write chain image, writeonly r32f image: the stores and loads reach the textures (checked by readback and by the fragment passes)
api.glTexStorage2D: immutable RGBA8 / R32UI / R32F textures required by image units
api.glTexParameteri: NEAREST filters (typed glTexParameter overloads) that make the R32F texture complete for texelFetch
api.glGenTextures: image fill, chain and texture-fetch textures
api.glBindTexture: sampler binding of the filled image and of the R32F texture
api.glUseProgram: compute, star, display and fragment programs
api.glGetUniformLocation: u_seed, u_slot, u_pass, u_tex, u_origin, u_scale
api.glUniform1ui: u_seed decides which sectors survive; u_slot selects the probe slot of every indirect command
api.glUniform1i: u_pass of the chain, sampler units and scale
api.glUniform2i: cell origin of the image display
api.glGenFramebuffers: framebuffer object for glReadPixels of the filled RGBA8 texture
api.glBindFramebuffer: FRAMEBUFFER target for the texture read-back and the default framebuffer for the display
api.glFramebufferTexture2D: attaches the filled texture to COLOR_ATTACHMENT0
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE: every texel of the filled image, probes of the star and all pixels of the three ByRegion pipelines in the capture
api.glDrawArrays: gl_VertexID triangles for the image display and the five fragment-shader pipelines
api.glClear: COLOR_BUFFER_BIT: the clear color is the expected pixel of culled sectors

visual_review.notes: 256x256 radeonsi es-max capture viewed at 1x and 3x (llvmpipe and zink differ by at most 1/255 per channel). Top left: five triangles (orange, green, dark gray, light green, yellow) pointing outwards on the dark background, three of the eight sectors empty. Top right: a checker of orange (x-ramp) and blue (y-ramp) 8x8-texel tiles at 2 pixels per texel with a white dot at the origin of every tile. Bottom left: diagonal-edged yellow/blue/gray stripes of 8 pixels (five-pass r32ui chain). Bottom right: upper strip a blocky pink/green XOR pattern, lower strip diagonal pink-to-teal ramps.
